_what: PRE-REGISTERED acceptance, method and expectations for qal/eye PHASE 2 -- COMPOSE THE TIMING BUDGET AND FIND THE FASTEST SUSTAINABLE WAVE. Written BEFORE any Phase-2 deck was run; at this instant qal/eye/p2/ held ONLY DISK_STATE_BEFORE.txt. Phase 1 (the EYE) is complete and its artifacts are READ-ONLY to this phase: I will not modify or re-run qal/eye/*.json, MARGIN_bank*.csv.gz, or anything in qal/banktank, qal/fcrit, qal/fastwave, qal/widebank, qal/cipher.
_scope: (a) charge every measured uncertainty against the eye; (b) shrink the beat until the eye closes under the full budget = the fastest sustainable wave; (c) compare against a LOAD-MATCHED CMOS level and against CMOS + flop tax at D = 1..10, giving the CROSSOVER D; (d) if the eye is narrower than the jitter, state the required timing reference as a SPEC ON THE TIMER.
_labels: MEASURED = read off a .prn/.mt0/.json in this or a named committed directory. DERIVED = arithmetic on MEASURED values. ASSUMED = neither. Every number in the deliverable carries one of these three.

IC_INSTRUMENT_CHECK_P2._doc: Phase 2 re-uses Phase 1's instrument, which was already digit-checked against the committed banktank headline row (INSTRUMENT_CHECK.json: IC1 byte-identical deck, IC2 440/440 .mt0 keys, IC3 15/15 scalars exact, IC4 100.0%). Phase 2's OWN instrument check is of the two things Phase 2 adds: the re-extraction path from the Phase-1 margin curves, and the provenance arithmetic of the inherited budget terms. NO SIMULATION is required for any IC below -- all four are re-extractions or arithmetic, stated in advance.
IC_INSTRUMENT_CHECK_P2.IC-P2-1_re_extract_the_Phase1_eye: Re-extract the EYE2 DATA_FIXED, 0 mV, first-contiguous-run HIGH-polarity opening for banks 1,2,3 directly from ../MARGIN_bank{1,2,3}.csv.gz by an INDEPENDENTLY WRITTEN reader (not eyecalc.py), and reproduce the committed EYE.json openings 328.599 / 529.641 / 729.382 ps. BAR: agreement to <= 0.10 ps (one grid cell), because the csv is the 0.10 ps grid and EYE.json's value came from sub-grid interpolation of the same curve.
IC_INSTRUMENT_CHECK_P2.IC-P2-2_reproduce_61.6_from_its_source: From /usr/local/src/stat-sim/qal/qal_bankN_zcs.json reproduce BOTH the 61.6 ps and the 16.9% of the brief's dominant term. PRE-STATED TARGET: max-min over the 9 Hamming-weight rows = 61.612 ps, and 61.612 / mean(t_zcs over the 9 rows) = 16.93%. BAR: exact to the printed digits of the source file.
IC_INSTRUMENT_CHECK_P2.IC-P2-3_reproduce_the_timer_terms: From qal/timer/RESULTS.json reproduce drift_rate_ps_per_K = 0.46 and the tracking ratio 16.4 (cold) with its two limbs, the LC-stiff ideal-probe zero +0.74% to 85C and the RC-soft loaded timer width +10.23% to 85C. BAR: exact.
IC_INSTRUMENT_CHECK_P2.IC-P2-4_reproduce_the_CMOS_and_flop_anch: From qal/sha256/p2/COMPARISON.json reproduce CMOS_level_at_2fF_ps = 57.143 and CMOS_level_at_6p91fF_ps = 94.174; from qal/restore5 reproduce t_reg = 307.1 / 335.7 / 390.0 ps at 0 / 6.91 / 20 fF and the liberty 1.11-1.21x optimism statement. BAR: exact.
IC_INSTRUMENT_CHECK_P2.IC_VERDICT_RULE: If IC-P2-1 fails, the Phase-1 margin curves cannot be re-read and Phase 2 stops and says so. If IC-P2-2/3/4 fail, the corresponding budget term is reported as UNVERIFIED PROVENANCE and is carried as ASSUMED, never as MEASURED.

B1_THE_61.6_ps_RECONCILIATION_STATED_IN_._doc: Phase 1 flagged the brief's dominant term as unreconciled: 61.6 ps / 16.9% 'N-invariant for worst-case data' against Phase 1's own measured per-hop rise-zero spread of 7.84/9.23/8.68/7.29 ps p-p at this operating point, a factor 6.7. I located the source BEFORE running anything and state the finding here so it cannot later look like a convenience.
B1_THE_61.6_ps_RECONCILIATION_STATED_IN_.SOURCE: /usr/local/src/stat-sim/qal/qal_bankN_zcs.json, sha256 fec5521ee11a2b7f, mtime 2026-09-25T00:01:45-0700. Its _doc: 'Zero-current (freeze) instant vs DATA for a real 8-gate QAL bank, switch held ON.' Cited as the provenance by qal/timer/PRE_REGISTERED.json: 'N=8 zero data-spread 61.6 ps / 16.9% at dV=0.8 (qal_bankN_zcs.json)'.
B1_THE_61.6_ps_RECONCILIATION_STATED_IN_.THE_OPERATING_POINT_MISMATCH_MEASURED: The source table is at dV = 0.8 V, L = 400 nH, C_A = 35.0025 fF, m_gates = 8, switch held ON, ONE bank. The eye is at dV = 1.65 V, L = 15 nH, C_tank = 359.79 fF (m = 10), switch opened at the true ZCS, FOUR cascaded banks. Every one of those five differs. The 61.6 ps figure is therefore MEASURED but NOT MEASURED AT THIS OPERATING POINT, and qal/timer's own citation says 'at dV=0.8' on its face.
B1_THE_61.6_ps_RECONCILIATION_STATED_IN_.WHAT_IS_INVARIANT_AND_WHAT_IS_NOT: 'N-invariant' in the source means invariant in the GATE COUNT N of one bank for worst-case data (the p-p is set by the two Hamming-weight extremes, which exist at every N). It does NOT claim invariance in dV, L, C_tank or topology. Phase 1's 7.84-9.23 ps is the SAME QUANTITY -- data-dependent spread of the rail-transfer zero over the 9 Hamming weights -- measured at the eye's own operating point.
B1_THE_61.6_ps_RECONCILIATION_STATED_IN_.PRE_STATED_CHARGING_RULE_THREE_READINGS: Because I cannot re-run the dV=0.8 point inside this study's scope, I will NOT pick one reading. The budget is composed and reported under all three, declared now: (R1) MEASURED-HERE, the spread measured at this operating point on the SAME arrangement; (R2) INHERITED-ABSOLUTE, the literal 61.6 ps; (R3) INHERITED-FRACTIONAL, 16.93% of the measured hop zero at this operating point (a scaling-law-preserving transfer of the source's own ratio). The headline verdict quotes R1 with R2 as the stress case, and the spread between them is reported as the dominant uncertainty in the budget, not hidden.
B1_THE_61.6_ps_RECONCILIATION_STATED_IN_.WHY_THIS_MATTERS: Phase 1: 'charged against 70.4 ps of slack, 61.6 ps nearly closes the budget while 9.2 ps leaves room.' The three readings therefore bracket the verdict and must all be shown.

B2_THE_ORACLE_TIMER_DISCOVERY_STATED_IN_._doc: Found by reading qal/banktank/bt.py BEFORE running any Phase-2 deck. This is the single largest correction Phase 2 makes to Phase 1's eye and it is stated here in advance.
B2_THE_ORACLE_TIMER_DISCOVERY_STATED_IN_.THE_MECHANISM_MEASURED_FROM_THE_SOURCE: bt.schedule (bt.py:101-130) sets o_k = c_k + tzr_k, the rail-raise switch OPEN instant, where tzr is the MEASURED true-ZCS vector. Phase 1's run_pattern.py RE-PROBED tzr/tzq PER DATA PATTERN with the full 8-run sequential protocol. So in Phase 1 every data pattern got its OWN switch schedule, derived from that pattern's own measured current zeros.
B2_THE_ORACLE_TIMER_DISCOVERY_STATED_IN_.WHY_THAT_IS_AN_ORACLE: A real machine has ONE calibrated timer. qal/sar/RESULTS_SAR.json states the architecture's condition explicitly: 'both options calibrate a fixed centered pattern' and the data spread 'is the irreducible term any calibrated timer leaves'. A per-pattern schedule is a timer that already knows the data. Phase 1's eye is therefore measured under an oracle timer and is OPTIMISTIC by an amount nobody has measured.
B2_THE_ORACLE_TIMER_DISCOVERY_STATED_IN_.STRUCTURAL_COROLLARY_I_ALSO_STATE_NOW: Phase 1's eye openings (c+128.599 / c+129.641 / c+129.382 ps) sit within -1.34 / +0.08 / +0.37 ps of that bank's own transfer_open_o_ps (c+129.935 / c+129.558 / c+129.010). The eye opening is LOCKED TO THE ZCS INSTANT. Hence t_valid is essentially the LC rail-transfer half-period, and the data-dependence of the eye opening is largely the data-dependence of the schedule that follows it. On a FIXED schedule that lock is broken and the eye must be re-measured.
B2_THE_ORACLE_TIMER_DISCOVERY_STATED_IN_.THE_PHASE_2_EXPERIMENT_THAT_REPLACES_THE: Instead of arguing over which number to charge for the data term, MEASURE it: run every data pattern on ONE calibrated schedule and read the eye degradation off the waveform. That converts the disputed 61.6-vs-9.2 ps assumption into a measurement on the arrangement that computes.
B2_THE_ORACLE_TIMER_DISCOVERY_STATED_IN_.A6_WILL_FAIL_BY_CONSTRUCTION_AND_THAT_IS: The inherited A6 gate (|I(L)| <= 1 uA at every commanded open) is a PROBE-VALIDITY gate: it certifies that a probe found the true zero. On a single calibrated schedule the off-centre patterns necessarily switch off-zero, so A6 MUST fail for them. Phase 1 measured exactly this cost when it substituted one pattern's zeros for another's: 11.6-26.7 uA. I pre-declare that on the calibrated schedule I will REPORT the residual |I(L)| per pattern as the measured switching-current cost of a calibrated timer, and will NOT treat its exceeding 1 uA as an instrument failure. A6 remains a gate on the CALIBRATION pattern's own probe, where it certifies the schedule.

B3_THE_BUDGET_TERMS_AND_THE_ANTI_DOUBLE_._doc: The constraint is a SETUP constraint at the receiver: t_valid_worst + SUM(uncertainties) <= T, where t_valid is the eye opening measured from the driver bank's own rail start c_k, and the receiver's aperture opens at c_(k+1) = c_k + T (Phase 1's sampling instant, and bt.py's own bnd_k = min(c_k+T, ...)). Slack at T = 200 ps is 70.359 ps (worst bank).

U1_DATA_DEPENDENT_SPREAD.charge: MEASURED as the eye-opening degradation from the per-pattern-oracle schedule to a single calibrated schedule, per B2, reported under readings R1/R2/R3 per B1.
U1_DATA_DEPENDENT_SPREAD.already_charged_warning_stated_in_advanc: Phase 1's intersection opening is ALREADY the worst over all 9 Hamming weights under the oracle schedule. Adding a data-spread term on top of that intersection WOULD DOUBLE COUNT the part of the spread the intersection already contains. The only legitimate additional charge is the ORACLE-TO-CALIBRATED degradation. I pre-commit to charging that difference and not the raw spread on top of the intersection.

U2_TIMER_DRIFT_AND_THE_TRACKING_RATIO_AR.charge: 0.46 ps/K (MEASURED, qal/timer/RESULTS.json drift_rate_ps_per_K) x 16 K (the recalibration interval holding the measured-benign band) = 7.36 ps, charged ONE-SIDED in the cold/early direction only.
U2_TIMER_DRIFT_AND_THE_TRACKING_RATIO_AR.THE_ANTI_DOUBLE_COUNT_ARITHMETIC_STATED_: 0.46 ps/K x 60 K (25C->85C) = 27.6 ps on the 265.623 ps nominal loaded timer width = 10.39%, which is the +10.23% RC-soft limb of the tracking ratio to within rounding. THE DRIFT RATE AND THE TRACKING RATIO'S SOFT LIMB ARE THE SAME MEASUREMENT EXPRESSED TWO WAYS. Charging 0.46 ps/K AND a separate 10.23% tracking term would double count. I charge it ONCE.
U2_TIMER_DRIFT_AND_THE_TRACKING_RATIO_AR.what_the_16.4_ratio_actually_contributes: It establishes that the term does NOT CANCEL. A perfectly tracking replica timer would cancel drift entirely. Here the timed quantity is LC-stiff (+0.74%/60K on the ideal-probe zero) while the timer is RC-soft (+10.23%/60K), ratio 16.4 cold / 13.9 hot. The LC limb's contribution over 16 K is 0.74% x (16/60) x t_valid ~= 0.26 ps at t_valid ~= 130 ps, i.e. NEGLIGIBLE, so the differential drift is essentially the timer's own. I will report the differential explicitly rather than asserting the cancellation either way.
U2_TIMER_DRIFT_AND_THE_TRACKING_RATIO_AR.THE_SAVING_SIGN_pre_stated: Hot -> RC-soft line slows -> T grows -> the sampling instant moves LATER -> MORE setup slack -> BENIGN. Cold -> line speeds up -> T shrinks -> sampling EARLIER -> LESS slack -> THE BAD DIRECTION. So the charge is one-sided cold. The cold limb is MEASURED as -4.82% on the loaded timer width (qal/timer/README.md), and I will report the -4.82% cold corner as a NAMED CORNER alongside the +/-16 K recalibration charge, because -4.82% of T is a much larger number than 7.36 ps and the two are different questions (recalibration interval vs full cold corner).

U3_MISMATCH.charge: Converted from VOLTAGE to TIME through the MEASURED margin slope at the early edge (Phase 1: 28-38 mV/ps). sigma_trip = 6.441 mV is a LOWER bound (dw/dl excluded, qal/vtaudit/AUDIT.md on its face; confirmed as arithmetic sqrt((0.4779*5.766)^2+(0.4630*12.574)^2) = 6.4409 mV by qal/fcrit_skept). Phase 1 MEASURED the 3-sigma early-edge cost as 0.53 / 0.78 / 1.71 ps.
U3_MISMATCH.A_SECOND_MISMATCH_TERM_I_STATE_NOW_BECAU: sigma_trip charges only the RECEIVER's decision level. The DRIVER's delivered level has its own mismatch: qal/mcsize MEASURED the exit HIGH-class level at 0.6618-0.6657 V +/- 19.4-22.4 mV over 300 samples. That is 3.0-3.5x sigma_trip and it is a different random variable. I pre-commit to reporting the mismatch time charge under BOTH sigma_trip alone (the brief's term) and sigma_total = sqrt(sigma_trip^2 + sigma_level^2) (the physically complete one), and to labelling which is which.
U3_MISMATCH.the_late_edge_is_a_HOLD_question_not_a_S: Phase 1's finding that 3 sigma CREATES a right edge at 1153.6 / 1356.6 ps is ~950 ps after c_k, while the setup instant is c_k + T <= 200 ps. Pre-stated: the 3-sigma right edge does NOT bind the setup budget at any T in this sweep, and I will verify that rather than assume it.

U4_THE_EXIT_RECEIVER_IS_A_CELL_CONSTRAIN.charge: ZERO ps. This is a boundary-condition constraint, not a term in the setup budget, and I state that classification in advance so it is not quietly converted into either.
U4_THE_EXIT_RECEIVER_IS_A_CELL_CONSTRAIN.MEASURED: qal/mcsize/README.md: at the chain exit (bank 4, the QAL->synchronous boundary), 300 MC samples give RX_SKEW (0.15 um-p / 1.48 um-n, trip 0.4595 V) 0/300 failures and RX_STD (1.12 um-p / 0.74 um-n, trip 0.6452 V) 191/300 failures = 36.33% yield [30.9, 42.1] 95% CI. Nominal exit HIGH sits 22 mV above the standard trip against a ~21 mV level sigma, i.e. ~1 sigma; the skewed receiver has ~10 sigma.
U4_THE_EXIT_RECEIVER_IS_A_CELL_CONSTRAIN.the_constraint: Every sustainable-beat number in this deliverable is conditional on the EXIT receiver being the skewed cell. With the standard cell the boundary is a coin flip at ANY beat, so no beat is sustainable and the timing budget is not the binding constraint. I will state this as a precondition on the result.
U4_THE_EXIT_RECEIVER_IS_A_CELL_CONSTRAIN.an_independent_confirmation_I_will_repor: qal/mcsize also measured that 3694/3900 pull-UP gate-instances fail at the open instant versus 0/3300 pull-DOWN. That independently confirms, under mismatch and on a different instrument, Phase 1's measured result that the binding polarity is HIGH at every bank.

B4_THE_SWEEP_AND_ITS_DECLARED_REDUCTIONS.arrangement: UNCHANGED from Phase 1 and from qal/banktank 0aae11e: m = 10 (C_tank 359.79 fF), dV = 1.65 V, L = 15 nH, Rs = 10 ohm, tg15p triple at W30, A6 tank-referenced park, free-running, 4 banks x 8 committed inverter cells (wp 1.12u / wn 0.74u, CL 2 fF), bank k cell i's gate input IS o{k-1}_{i}, no flop/latch/buffer/keeper/level-shifter anywhere. The harness imports bt.py verbatim (sha256 5b3582bea9e398e4) and overrides only what Phase 1's PRE_REGISTERED.json already declares (bt.PAT, the .tran print/max step, bt.HERE/CACHE/ENV) PLUS ONE NEW DECLARED OVERRIDE: the zeros vector z passed to bt.do_row is the CALIBRATION pattern's, not the running pattern's. Nothing in the netlist is added, removed or re-sized.
B4_THE_SWEEP_AND_ITS_DECLARED_REDUCTIONS.time_base: 0.10 ps max-step ceiling, 0.05 ps print step -- identical to Phase 1, so Phase-1 and Phase-2 curves are directly comparable. Phase 1's CONVERGENCE.json already established that the 0.25->0.10 ps refinement moves eye openings by <= 0.0018 ps, so the grid is not the limit; edges are located by the same GUARDED sub-grid interpolation (Phase 1 AMENDMENT E1 + the E6 bug fix).
B4_THE_SWEEP_AND_ITS_DECLARED_REDUCTIONS.CALIBRATION_PATTERN: P3 = [1,0,1,0,1,0,1,0], Hamming weight 4 = the CENTRED pattern of an 8-gate bank, chosen because qal/sar states the architecture calibrates 'a fixed centered pattern'. Its zeros are probed in FULL 8-run sequential protocol at every T, and A6 is gated on that probe.
B4_THE_SWEEP_AND_ITS_DECLARED_REDUCTIONS.T_LADDER: T in {200, 180, 160, 150, 140} ps at H = 4, dV = 1.65, free. 200 anchors to Phase 1. Refinement between the last passing and first failing T if the closure lands between rungs.
B4_THE_SWEEP_AND_ITS_DECLARED_REDUCTIONS.H_PROBE: One additional point at H = 2 at the sustainable T, because the INITIATION INTERVAL is H*T + tzq and H therefore dominates the throughput verdict, and H = 2 is unmeasured at dV = 1.65 (banktank has H = 2 only at dV = 1.2). If H = 2 does not hold value-correctness, the throughput verdict is reported at H = 4 and the H = 2 attempt is reported as a failed attempt, not omitted.
B4_THE_SWEEP_AND_ITS_DECLARED_REDUCTIONS.PATTERN_REDUCTION_AND_ITS_CHECK: At every T I run {P1 (w0), P2 (w8), P3 (w4, the calibration centre)}. Phase 1 MEASURED that the complete-space eye is IDENTICAL to the 6-pattern eye on banks 1-3 because the Hamming-weight EXTREMES bind, and that the eye depends only on weight, not arrangement (P4 control: ZCS agreeing to 3e-9 ps, all 76 rail keys identical to 0.000 V). VERIFICATION, pre-committed: at T = 200 AND at the final sustainable T I run ALL NINE weights and confirm the intersection is set by {w0, w8}. IF IT IS NOT, the reduction is DISCARDED and every T is re-run in full. This verification is mandatory because Phase 1's own oddeven4 lesson is that an inherited reduction can fail silently at a new operating point.
B4_THE_SWEEP_AND_ITS_DECLARED_REDUCTIONS.EXTRACTION: ONE transient per (T, pattern) configuration. The sampling instant is swept by READING the dense waveform. No deck is ever re-run for a different sampling instant. Margin is the signed distance to the receiver's MEASURED trip on the 27-point qal/fcrit/TRIP.json cell-S curve, interpolated by fcrit/rescore.py class Trip verbatim; the trip FRACTION is never treated as a constant (MEASURED 0.728124 at 0.20 V to 0.517850 at 1.50 V); 0.59 is never used. Both references (EYE1 RX_INSTANTANEOUS, EYE2 DATA_FIXED) and both polarities are carried, with EYE2 the headline per Phase 1's E3.

B5_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS_so_they_can_b.EY1_oracle_to_calibrated_cost: The calibrated-schedule eye opens LATER than Phase 1's oracle eye at the worst pattern, by 5-25 ps, point estimate 12 ps. Confidence MEDIUM. Rationale: the oracle-to-calibrated schedule error is bounded by the measured ZCS spread (7.84-9.23 ps p-p) and the rail-level error it causes converts to time at 28-38 mV/ps.
B5_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS_so_they_can_b.EY2_t_valid_is_NOT_T_invariant: t_valid (eye opening measured from own rail start) GROWS as T shrinks, by 0-15 ps over T = 200 -> 140, point estimate +6 ps. Confidence MEDIUM-HIGH. Rationale: bt.py's own AMENDMENT A7 MEASURED that the rail-transfer zero is beat-period dependent through a bank's INPUT levels during its own ramp (T=120 zeros used at T=200 left 8.8/15.3/27.4 uA residual), so the LC half-period is not the whole story.
B5_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS_so_they_can_b.EY3_the_sustainable_beat: T_sustainable lands in 145-175 ps, point estimate 158 ps, under reading R1. Under R2 (the literal 61.6 ps) it lands in 195-215 ps. Confidence MEDIUM.
B5_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS_so_they_can_b.EY4_crossover_D: QAL's throughput beats a CMOS pipeline flopped every level for D >= 2, and beats the best iso-D CMOS for D >= 3. Confidence LOW-MEDIUM -- this depends on the initiation interval H*T + tzq, which is 4-5x the beat and is the term most likely to overturn the verdict.
B5_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS_so_they_can_b.EY5_mismatch_is_cheap_in_TIME_at_the_ear: The 3-sigma mismatch time charge is < 5 ps even under sigma_total, because the early-edge margin slope is 28-38 mV/ps. Confidence HIGH.
B5_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATIONS_so_they_can_b.EY6_the_binding_bank: Bank 2 remains the binding bank (worst setup slack) at every T. Confidence MEDIUM.

B6_PRE_DECLARED_FAILURE_HANDLING.F1_probe_finds_no_zero: Report the (T, pattern, phase, bank) and quarantine the deck under FAILED/; do not substitute a neighbouring T's zeros silently.
B6_PRE_DECLARED_FAILURE_HANDLING.F2_A6_fails_on_the_CALIBRATION_pattern_o: The schedule itself is invalid -> re-probe. Distinct from A6 failing on off-centre patterns on the calibrated schedule, which is EXPECTED per B2 and is REPORTED as the measured cost of a calibrated timer.
B6_PRE_DECLARED_FAILURE_HANDLING.F3_no_opening_inside_the_beat: If at some T no contiguous open run exists in [c_k, c_k + T] for some bank, that T is CLOSED and is reported as the closure point with the bank and mechanism named.
B6_PRE_DECLARED_FAILURE_HANDLING.F4_reduction_disagrees: If the 9-weight verification at T = 200 or at the final T shows the intersection is not set by {w0, w8}, DISCARD the reduction and re-run every T with all nine weights. Report that this happened.
B6_PRE_DECLARED_FAILURE_HANDLING.F5_a_number_I_cannot_reconcile: Flag it in the deliverable with its source and both values, as Phase 1 did with 61.6 ps. Do not absorb it into a headline.
B6_PRE_DECLARED_FAILURE_HANDLING.F6_scope_honesty: Bank 4 is DERIVED (no bank 5 exists in a 4-bank deck) and is never a headline number, exactly as in Phase 1. Energy is REPORTED, never a gate. NO LATENCY WIN is claimed anywhere: a QAL level is the rail transfer with the logic resolving inside it at a LOWER rail than CMOS's supply, so per-level latency can never beat CMOS; any win must be throughput via the absent flop tax.

B7_THE_COMPARISON_DEFINITIONS_FIXED_BEFO._doc: Fixed in advance so the comparison cannot be chosen after the beat is known.
B7_THE_COMPARISON_DEFINITIONS_FIXED_BEFO.LOAD_MATCHED_CMOS_LEVEL: 57.143 ps, the 2 fF figure -- BECAUSE the banktank cells this eye is measured on carry CL = 2.0 fF. The 94.174 ps figure is the 6.91 fF convention and quoting it here would flatter QAL by 94.174/57.143 = 1.648x. Both are reported; the verdict uses 57.143 ps. This follows the precedent already set in qal/sha256/p2/COMPARISON.json, which made the same choice for the same reason.
B7_THE_COMPARISON_DEFINITIONS_FIXED_BEFO.t_reg_AT_THE_MATCHED_LOAD: DERIVED by linear interpolation between the MEASURED 307.1 ps at 0 fF and 335.7 ps at 6.91 fF: t_reg(2 fF) = 307.1 + (2.0/6.91)*(335.7-307.1) = 315.38 ps. The liberty numbers are 1.11-1.21x OPTIMISTIC per restore5's transistor cross-check, so 315.38 ps is a LOWER bound on the flop tax -- which is the CONSERVATIVE choice for QAL (a smaller flop tax is less QAL advantage). The 1.11-1.21x inflation is reported as an upside band, never folded into the headline.
B7_THE_COMPARISON_DEFINITIONS_FIXED_BEFO.CLOCK_UNCERTAINTY_AS_NAMED_CORNERS: unc = 0 (ideal) / 100 (tree) / 250 (flow) ps, the three NAMED corners already carried by qal/restore5/PRE_REGISTERED.json. The headline uses unc = 0, the corner most hostile to QAL. All three are reported.
B7_THE_COMPARISON_DEFINITIONS_FIXED_BEFO.QAL_INITIATION_INTERVAL: II = H*T + tzq, where tzq is the MEASURED return zero (Phase 1 P3 at T=200: 148.13/152.93/153.45/147.09 ps). II, not T, is the throughput denominator, because a bank cannot accept a new datum until its rail has returned and the return switch has opened at its own zero. I state in advance that II is 4-5x the beat at H = 4 and that this is the term most likely to sink the throughput claim.
B7_THE_COMPARISON_DEFINITIONS_FIXED_BEFO.THE_TWO_CROSSOVER_Ds_BOTH_REPORTED: (i) vs CMOS flopped EVERY level: QAL wins when II/D < t_reg + t_level + unc, i.e. D > II/(t_reg+t_level+unc). (ii) vs the BEST iso-D CMOS, flopped every D levels: QAL wins when II < t_reg + D*t_level + unc, i.e. D > (II - t_reg - unc)/t_level. (ii) is the harder and fairer test and both are reported for D = 1..10 at all three unc corners.
B7_THE_COMPARISON_DEFINITIONS_FIXED_BEFO.LEVELS_PER_BANK: banktank's cells are INVERTERS = ONE logic level per bank, and that is what is MEASURED. The user's model allows at most TWO transistor levels per bank. The crossover is computed for BOTH, with 1 level/bank labelled MEASURED and 2 levels/bank labelled ARCHITECTURAL (a capability of the arrangement, not a measurement of it).
B7_THE_COMPARISON_DEFINITIONS_FIXED_BEFO.NOT_COMPARABLE_AND_SAID_SO: qal/fastwave's beats are on a pass-gate TG-XOR cell (t_level 205-322 ps) and qal/widebank's on N = 16..256 banks. Neither is this arrangement and neither is quoted as a beat against it.

B8_SIM_DISCIPLINE.models: sg13_lv via qal/sg13lv_compat.sp (declares and DISCARDS ad/as/pd/ps so PSP103 defaults apply and JUNCAP200 IS enabled; default PD = 1.00 um < the 1.12 um pMOS so the STI-edge term clips to zero -- any leakage figure is a LOWER bound). PSP103 via .hdl + sg13g2_psp103_tt.lib. 1F-integrator or INTEG-I(Vsrc)+PARAM metering only, always t0-referenced for the t=0 pedestal. vt/gmin reserved. Unique .va module names. Corners only via instance-level DTA -- and NO DTA corner is used in this phase, so every temperature statement here is an arithmetic charge on qal/timer's MEASURED drift, never a re-simulation.
